design.primary: All thresholds/rankings frozen on 2013-18 train + 2019-22 validation. 2023-25 opened afterward. Candidate must beat same outcome/price-band baseline.
design.recent: Recent-only source families use explicit time-forward development/validation/holdout windows and can only become RECENT_SHADOW_WATCH.
design.movement: 2015-16 continuous multi-book movement is diagnostic/confirmation evidence only; it is not used to originate long-history methods.
design.existing_methods: Active arsenal rules remain frozen. New-feature vetoes are discovered preholdout and validated on 2023-25.
